rules.title: Prohibition on algorithmic devices to set rents
rules.requirement: The sale or use of algorithmic devices to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units is prohibited in San Francisco.
rules.summary_plain: In San Francisco, landlords cannot use software or devices that analyze competitor rental data to set rents or manage occupancy.
rules.summary_plain_es: En San Francisco, los propietarios no pueden usar software o dispositivos que analicen datos de alquileres de competidores para fijar rentas o gestionar la ocupación.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to all residential rental units in San Francisco.
rules.penalty: Allows tenants or the City Attorney to bring a civil action for violations.
rules.quoted_span: The law prohibits the sale or use of algorithmic devices to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units in San Francisco.
